methodology.signalSide: For each divergence channel, use the highest Phase-1 signal item score mapped to that channel, including primary and secondary matched categories, then normalize by the Phase-1 item score ceiling.
methodology.marketSide: Use the market-reading channel z-score from dashboard/public/market-readings.json: max absolute z-score among the channel instruments, with the driver instrument named.
methodology.classification: radar-claim = elevated signal and quiet market; priced = elevated signal and moving market; radar-miss = quiet signal and moving market; calm = quiet signal and quiet market.
